description: The OptimalControlProblems.jl package is part of the control-toolbox ecosystem. The control-toolbox ecosystem gathers Julia packages for mathematical control and applications. The root package is OptimalControl.jl which aims to provide tools to model and solve optimal control problems with ordinary differential equations by direct and indirect methods, both on CPU and GPU.
title: OptimalControlProblems.jl: a collection of optimal control problems with ODE's in Julia
